name: RIPEstat Data API
tier_rationale: RIPE NCC is a Regional Internet Registry (A8 trusted: internet registries and RIRs); P031 and P345 trusted.

reliability.justification: RIPE NCC registry and routing data from the RIR itself; rir-geo and maxmind-geo-lite answers are MaxMind-derived geolocation context only (P031 cond 6).

data_api.title: RIPEstat Data API /data/{call}/data.json (network-info, prefix-overview, as-overview, announced-prefixes, whois, abuse-contact-finder, ...)

terms.quote: Keyless RIPEstat Data API (stat.ripe.net/data/<call>/data.json), sourceapp=v3lum on every call, attribution to RIPE NCC per its terms.

data_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P031 cond 1); research C0075 terms '[live_cti] RIPE NCC terms of service (free, attribution)' (verified_live 200). For legal's record: the RIPEstat Service Terms and Conditions (checked 2026-11-26) art. 3.3 forbid re-packaging or redistributing the service or its data, and commercial products or paid services based on it need the RIPE NCC's written permission; internal defensive use is outside that clause and V3LUM never redistributes RIPEstat data. Calls network-info, prefix-overview, rir-geo, whois, abuse-contact-finder, reverse-dns-ip, as-overview, announced-prefixes (streamed, <= 100 cidr pivots), asn-neighbours, searchcomplete and dns-chain (P031 cond 2, 4). JSON envelope errors in 200 (status, status_code, messages of type error) map to ERROR or RATE_LIMITED through P321 markers the owning batch adds with its error-envelope fixture (P031 cond 3, 7). RIPE person objects are dropped at ingestion (P031 cond 5). Used by ripestat and takedown_packet (the abuse-contact helper; the exporter itself makes no calls, P345 cond 1).

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G02-1, p2-G03-1 (P031, P345): batches only extend it (ripestat__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). sourceapp=v3lum on every call (module level); fair use with no hard published limit: no quota block, concurrency 4 stays under the ~8 concurrent requests the research warns about (research C0075), ttl 24 h (P031 cond 1).
